newsitem.title: USA: Sparks sees 96 US corn 9.29 bln bu, soy 2.40-trade.
newsitem.headline: Sparks sees 96 US corn 9.29 bln bu, soy 2.40-trade.

text.p: Widely watched commodity advisory firm Sparks Cos has estimated the final 1996 U.S. corn crop at 9.295 billion bushels and the soybean crop at 2.403 billion bushels, according to trade sources.
Sources at Sparks, based in Memphis, Tenn., declined to comment on the numbers.

USDA is set to release final crop production estimates for 1996 on Jan 10. The latest corn production figure from USDA was 9.265 billion bushels, and the latest soybean production figure was 2.403 billion.
